Includes packaged asr_waveform.hama and hama.wasm, unmodified.
Changes: inline JSON vocab imports to run as native browser ES modules;
remove source map links; add same-origin Cache Storage to engine.browser.js.
Only phoneme ASR is used. G2P/P2G model weights are not included or loaded.
